## Summary

## Definition of Done

See [docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md](../docs/DEFINITION_OF_DONE.md). Check all that apply.

- [ ] Tests cover the change; ADR added for non-obvious choices
- [ ] `make all` passes and continuous integration is green
- [ ] Numbers in the README and docs come from committed results and say how to reproduce them
- [ ] Diagrams re-rendered with `make diagram` when the architecture changed
- [ ] Model card, data card and threat model current where they exist
- [ ] No secrets committed; CodeQL passes

## Evidence

Benchmark numbers, test output or screenshots that show the change works.
